title: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank, Quontic Bank Acquisition Corp., and Quontic Bank Holdings Corp.
raw_text:
September 04, 2026
Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank, Quontic Bank Acquisition Corp., and Quontic Bank Holdings Corp.
For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Friday announced the termination of the enforcement actions listed below:
United Texas Bank, Dallas, Texas
Cease and Desist Order dated August 29, 2024 (PDF)
Terminated September 2, 2026
Quontic Bank Acquisition Corp., Astoria, New York, and Quontic Bank Holdings Corp., Astoria, New York
Written Agreement dated July 5, 2023 (PDF)
Terminated September 2, 2026
Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here.
For media inquiries, please email [email protected] or call 202-452-2955.
